items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health News; Source link: A leadership update from Mackenzie Health
items.verbatim_snippet: After more than 14 years of executive leadership, President and CEO Altaf Stationwala departed Mackenzie Health to assume the role of President and CEO at Unity Health, effective June 27, 2025.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health News; Source link: A leadership update from Mackenzie Health
items.verbatim_snippet: Mary-Agnes Wilson, who previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, and Chief Nursing Executive, was appointed as interim President and CEO effective July 1, 2025, ensuring operational stability and uninterrupted execution of strategic priorities while a national search was conducted.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health News; Source link: Announcing Mackenzie Health's new President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Stumpo transitioned from his role as President and CEO of Orillia Soldiers' Memorial Hospital, succeeding interim CEO Mary-Agnes Wilson to steer Mackenzie Health through its regional growth and expanding academic partnerships, including its role as a lead partner with York University’s School of Medicine.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health News; Source link: Announcing Mackenzie Health's new President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Following a comprehensive national search process, Mackenzie Health appointed Carmine Stumpo as its new permanent President and Chief Executive Officer, effective April 13, 2026.

Notably, Dr. Joby McKenzie and Ruby Philip-Katyal stepped into Vice-Chair capacities in June 2024, and long-standing board members such as Fay Lim-Lambie and Ruby Philip-Katyal completed their terms upon the June 2025 governance transition.
